title: Why Dexter Lawrence is the key to Cincinnati’s newly dangerous defensive line

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Why Dexter Lawrence is the key to Cincinnati’s newly dangerous defensive line
sources.description: A year after fielding the worst early-season defense in DVOA history, Cincinnati spent big on Lawrence, Jonathan Allen and Boye Mafe. Five games in, the pressure and sack numbers show it’s working.
